column2: Bihar’s per capita GDP was Rs 68,624 in 2023-24, the lowest in
the country among all states. Per capita GDP at all-India level
was Rs 2,15,935. Per capita GDP also varies widely across
districts. In 2023-24, Patna recorded the highest per capita GDP
GDP in all other districts was below one lakh rupees in 2023-24.
In 11 districts, per capita GDP in 2023-24 was lower than Rs
50,000. Sheohar and Araria recorded the lowest per capita GDP
Source: Advance estimates of GDP for 2025-26, National Accounts,
